compiler.validation: Profile 0.18 bounded builders and native application consumers

evidence.ref: RAVEL, mncs-test, mncs-actions native bounded selection paths
evidence.summary: Development-stack compaction and selected-element materialization use shared bounded builders without host lists.
No general mutable buffer or arbitrary scatter-write primitive was introduced.

reproduction.instructions: Run the bounded builder backend suite and compare it with the legacy frame_generic/view-to-exact scatter reproducer.

summary: Bounded filtering, materialization, runtime-length views, and capacity-checked functional pushes remain available and are used by RAVEL, mncs-test, and Actions. General indexed mutation, arbitrary scatter-write, and unrestricted view-to-exact construction remain absent.

workaround.description: Use explicit bounded functional builders and retain the scatter pressure for future bulk construction work.
